cases.expect: Invalid participant or score leaves no parent, scores or receipt
Invalid payload leaves all previous metadata, scores and receipt state intact
Deletion and receipt commit together; a failure leaves parent and children intact
Anon and ordinary JWTs are denied before lookup or receipt replay; user_metadata cannot grant admin
Admin can edit another historical owner; owner and noneditable metadata stay unchanged
Retained score IDs, color and role survive updates
Null, zero, negatives and decimals above JavaScript integer precision remain exact
SQL jsonb::text byte boundaries match the contract validator, including Unicode and escaped text
Detail and revision come from one snapshot and are independent of session timezone
Stale revision returns HTTP409 before mutation
Two different updates on one revision produce one commit and one HTTP409
Same actor/request/payload produces one create and one replay
Different operation, target, revision or payload with same key returns HTTP409
Update and delete receipts remain replayable after the target is removed
A new token without admin cannot replay a former admin receipt
Current NULL, winner, tie and cooperative behaviour is preserved; metadata-only edits keep positions
Metadata and nullable external positions commit with scores; duplicate actor/table does not create another play
Ratings and recalc runs stay unchanged; only existing play-deletion cascades affect linked history
After a separately tested local cutover, direct DML and old score RPC cannot bypass atomic writers
Local imports and the synthetic server position adapter reject obsolete snapshots; real jobs are not integrated
Historical manual/null source, null game or winner and unsupported participant counts are shown explicitly; no silent conversion or truncation on edit
